test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The traffic police told me that I couldn't park my two-wheeler there.

options.text: The traffic police told me, "I couldn't park my two-wheeler here."
The traffic police said, "Do not park the two-wheeler here."
The traffic police said to me, "I can't park my two-wheeler there."
The traffic police said to me, "You can't park your two-wheeler here."

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The traffic police told me that I couldn't park my two-wheeler there.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"that I couldn't park" becomes "You can't park"**
 
 
• Indirect statement "that I couldn't park" is converted to direct statement "You can't park."
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "couldn't" is changed to "can't" to match the present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"there" becomes "here"**
 
 
• The adverb "there" is converted to "here" to match the direct speech context.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "told me"
 
• Converted to: "said to me" to match the direct speech format.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "You" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You can't park your two-wheeler here," said the traffic police to me.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "I couldn't park my two-wheeler here," said the traffic police to me.
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun "I" instead of "You".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Do not park the two-wheeler here," said the traffic police to me.
 
 
• Changes from a statement to a command.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I can't park my two-wheeler there," said the traffic police to me.
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun "I" instead of "You" and "there" instead of "here".
 
 

``
